title: Reuse standard components and shared UI primitives
statement: Before creating a control, badge, pane, card, dialog, or status treatment, reuse the established standard component or shared primitive. Extend the shared family when a capability is genuinely missing.
rationale: One-off UI primitives duplicate behavior, accessibility, states, and styling. Shared Agent Studio and Quality Studio primitives keep interactions consistent and defects fixable in one place.

history.change: Initial default-on rule covering the operator-observed missing component reuse defect class.
